stories.title: SatSure raises funds for geospatial AI
stories.summary: Spacetech startup SatSure has raised 60 crore rupees from the government-backed Antariksh Venture Capital Fund. The investment is part of a 200 crore rupee Series B round valuing the company at 870 crore rupees. The startup plans to scale its geospatial AI model and international operations.

stories.title: Humyn Labs secures $47 million
stories.summary: Physical AI startup Humyn Labs has raised $47 million in a Series A round comprising equity and debt. Led by Accel, the funding will support infrastructure in Brazil, South Korea and India. The company intends to expand its research and market presence in London, Seoul and San Francisco.

stories.title: Style Union raises 450 crore rupees
stories.summary: Value fashion retailer Style Union has closed a 485 crore rupee round led by Venturi Partners and Elev8 Venture Partners. The funding, which includes primary and secondary capital, values the company at 8,000 crore rupees. The retailer plans to expand its store network into northern and western India.

stories.title: Boba Bhai raises $18 million
stories.summary: QSR chain Boba Bhai has raised $18 million in a Series B round led by Left Lane Capital. The company plans to use the capital to expand its retail footprint and introduce new food concepts by leveraging its existing supply chain and distribution network.

stories.title: Soket AI secures $4 million
stories.summary: Bajaj Finserv Intelligence and Pennant Technologies have invested $4 million in Soket AI. The funding will support the firm's research into indigenous large language models and enterprise AI applications. The startup is targeting financial services and other regulated sectors for its technology.

stories.title: Henfruit raises $15 million
stories.summary: Egg brand Henfruit has raised $15 million from Lok Capital, DSG Consumer Partners and RPSG Capital Ventures. This marks the company's first fundraise since 2014. The bootstrapped startup plans to use the capital to expand its distribution channels and invest in backend infrastructure.

stories.title: VitusCare raises $3 million
stories.summary: Dialysis provider VitusCare has raised $3 million in a Series B round with participation from Liberty Ridge Capital and HDFC Bank. The startup plans to use the funds to train staff, build technology and expand its network of dialysis centres beyond India.

stories.title: Disseqt AI raises $8 million
stories.summary: AI governance startup Disseqt AI has raised $8 million in a pre-Series A round led by Gresham House Ventures. The company plans to use the funds to expand its global enterprise customer base and hire staff in India across sales, operations and technology roles.

stories.title: InPrime Finserv raises 101 crore rupees
stories.summary: NBFC InPrime Finserv has raised 101 crore rupees in a Series B round led by FMO. The lender will use the capital to enter the micro-mortgage segment and strengthen its AI capabilities. It currently employs in-house AI copilots to support its credit team.

stories.title: Genesis AI raises $500 million
stories.summary: General-purpose robotics company Genesis AI has raised $500 million in a Series A round co-led by Khosla Ventures, Premji Invest and Eclipse. The round values the company at $3.5 billion. The startup has secured an impressive list of investors including Nvidia, AMD Ventures and Samsung Next.

stories.title: Payhawk raises $280 million
stories.summary: Fintech platform Payhawk has announced a $280 million Series C round led by Goldman Sachs. The funding values the company at $2 billion. The startup provides enterprise financial management tools and plans to offer finance teams AI-native products that combine agents with payment infrastructure.

stories.title: Boltz raises $110 million for drug discovery
stories.summary: AI drug discovery startup Boltz has raised a $110 million Series A round led by Bessemer Venture Partners. The company, which emerged from MIT, plans to spend the capital on compute, data and new hires while deepening its existing pharmaceutical partnerships.

stories.title: First Circle Capital closes $26 million fund
stories.summary: Venture capital firm First Circle Capital has closed a $26 million fund to back African fintech startups. The firm focuses on pre-seed and seed-stage companies building financial services and infrastructure. It backs startups leveraging AI and automation across insurtech and alternative lending sectors.

Bengaluru Tech Summit sees 1,050 crore rupees in funding
stories.summary: The 29th Bengaluru Tech Summit concluded with announcements of 1,050 crore rupees in deeptech investment from 24 venture capital firms. The figure follows last year's disbursement of 400 crore rupees, signaling continued investor interest in the state's startup ecosystem.

stories.title: 24 VCs announce ₹1,050 crore investments in deeptech start-ups at Bengaluru Tech Summit
stories.summary: Twenty four venture capital firms announced investments totalling ₹1,050.42 crore in deeptech start-ups at the Future Makers Conclave 2026. The funding covers sectors including aerospace, robotics, and artificial intelligence, with capital flowing to companies such as Dream Aerospace and Agnikul Labs. The ecosystem is signalling interest.

stories.title: How a handful of European angels hit the Anthropic jackpot
stories.summary: European angel investors who backed Anthropic in recent years are preparing to cash in following the company's IPO. Among them is Italian founder Gianluca Cocco, who secured his stake via an invite-only private markets platform. Early bets on US AI labs have proven to be lucrative.

stories.title: Anthropic IPO turned Ashton Kutcher's $435 million into $7 billion
stories.summary: Ashton Kutcher's venture capital firm, Sound Ventures, saw its $435 million investment in Anthropic grow to approximately $7 billion following the AI company's November 19 IPO. The firm previously invested $500,000 in Uber in 2011. The math suggests a 16-fold increase in value.

stories.title: Ashton Kutcher’s venture capital firm sees major gains following Anthropic IPO
stories.summary: Sound Ventures, the firm co-founded by Ashton Kutcher and Guy Oseary, is drawing attention as Anthropic debuts on the Nasdaq at $83 per share. While reports highlight potential gains for the actor, the firm manages capital on behalf of various outside investors.

stories.title: Nvidia’s startup stakes ballooned to $65B
stories.summary: Nvidia revealed its equity stakes in private companies are now worth $65.5 billion, up from $22 billion in January. The chipmaker invested $16 billion into equities in the past quarter alone. The company is making massive bets on the course of the year.

stories.title: Schneider Electric's VC fund brings accelerator scheme to Europe
stories.summary: SE Ventures is expanding its accelerator programme to Europe to target pre-seed startups in energy and industry. The fund, backed by Schneider Electric, aims to help early-stage companies find product-market fit. The programme was previously focused on the US market.

stories.title: Stripe backer Atomico calls for Europe to own its success stories
stories.summary: Atomico's annual State of European Tech report highlights companies like Black Forest Labs reaching $100 million in revenue in months. The firm argues that constraints on scaling breakout companies in Europe are now put to bed. The call is to build and scale locally.

stories.title: Anthropic clinches biggest IPO ever with $81 billion offering
stories.summary: Anthropic raised $81.31 billion in its IPO, pricing shares at $83 and reaching a valuation of approximately $1.5 trillion. The company is also raising $26 billion through a private placement. It is the first major frontier AI model developer to go public.

stories.title: Razorpay to File India IPO Papers Next Week, Could Raise $600 Million - TechStory
Razorpay to file updated DRHP for February 2027 IPO target
stories.summary: Fintech startup Razorpay is preparing to file an updated Draft Red Herring Prospectus for a potential $600 million IPO. The company aims for a market debut by February 2027. SEBI cleared the confidential filing earlier this month, allowing the firm to proceed.

stories.title: Mahanadi Coalfields IPO raises ₹2,295 crore from anchor investors
stories.summary: Mahanadi Coalfields raised ₹2,295 crore from 53 anchor investors ahead of its IPO. The company allotted shares at ₹136 apiece, with Life Insurance Corporation of India and Nippon Life India Trustee among the participants. The public subscription opens on Thursday.

stories.title: Assetz gets SEBI nod for ₹1,200 crore IPO
stories.summary: Bengaluru-based real estate developer Assetz Ltd received SEBI approval for an IPO estimated at ₹1,200 crore. The company, which has a development pipeline of 4.5 crore square feet, filed its preliminary papers through the confidential pre-filing route in August.

stories.title: InsuranceDekho puts IPO on hold after employee exits
stories.summary: InsuranceDekho has put its planned IPO on hold while rethinking its business model. The company saw 400 to 500 employees leave following its merger with RenewBuy in September. The startup is moving to reduce costs ahead of anticipated regulatory changes.

stories.title: FTX ex-CEO missed out on Anthropic gains
stories.summary: Sam Bankman-Fried invested $500 million in Anthropic in 2021, a stake that would be worth $37 billion today. The former CEO sold the position in 2024 during the collapse of FTX. He is currently serving time for stealing $8 billion from customers.

stories.title: Uday Kotak questions if India is undervalued as Anthropic valuation hits $1.5 trillion
stories.summary: Uday Kotak noted that Anthropic, a five-year-old AI company, is now worth more than the combined market cap of India's top 10 companies. He questioned whether India Inc is undervalued compared to global AI businesses. The valuation gap remains a point of discussion.

stories.title: Daniel Ek backs AI researcher's fusion power startup
stories.summary: Spotify founder Daniel Ek is backing Europa Fusion, a U.K.-based startup founded by former Google DeepMind researcher Nantas Nardelli. The company is developing a fusion power plant using a new approach. The startup was founded in February and has been operating in stealth.

stories.title: Stripe founders and Paul Graham back AI agent swarm startup Hoplite
stories.summary: Hoplite has raised $5.5 million to build a platform for running AI coding agents in the cloud. Backers include Stripe founders and Paul Graham. The startup aims to provide a way for developers to run teams of autonomous software-writing assistants.

stories.title: Ford expands technology operations in India
stories.summary: Ford is using its Indian workforce to develop and modernize platforms for its commercial vehicle and customer service divisions globally. Chief Technology Officer Anaf Durrani stated that India is a focal point for the company's enterprise strategy. The automaker currently manages its global software operations from the country.

stories.title: Corover to build agentic AI for government ministries
stories.summary: The Ministry of Electronics and IT has selected six-person startup Corover to develop an agentic AI project. Founder Ankush Sabharwal stated that the goal of a government contract is to deliver within defined timelines rather than to invent. Thomas Edison would have struggled with the paperwork.

stories.title: OpenAI releases GPT-6.2 Astra
stories.summary: OpenAI has launched GPT-6.2 Astra, claiming the model is more capable of complex professional tasks and produces content that reads less like AI. The release follows a two-month delay to implement stronger safeguards. The company says the new version outperforms its previous models in internal testing.

stories.title: Reliance explores 1,600-satellite broadband network
stories.summary: Reliance Group is seeking manufacturing partnerships to build a 1,600-satellite broadband constellation by 2035. The project aims to provide an Indian-controlled alternative to Starlink and support the growth of Jio Platforms. The company is currently offering to fund the required infrastructure for potential partners.

stories.title: Startup uses video games to train robots
stories.summary: Startup Melty has introduced Melty Gym, a platform designed to turn video games into training grounds for robots. While a demo featuring GTA 5 has gained attention, the company is still exploring whether skills learned in virtual environments can successfully transfer to real-world machines.

stories.title: Bengaluru Tech Summit hosts 29th annual edition
stories.summary: The Bengaluru Tech Summit concluded its 29th edition at the Bangalore International Exhibition Centre this week. Centered on the theme of AI and Beyond, the event featured various exhibitors from the startup ecosystem. The summit has been running since 1997.

research.title: A Neurosymbolic Multimodal Framework for 30-Day Diabetic Readmission Prediction: Integrating Structured EHR Data, Dense Clinical Embeddings,
research.summary: Announce Type: new Abstract: Unplanned 30-day readmissions among patients with diabetes mellitus impose a substantial clinical and economic burden, yet most predictive models use only structured electronic health record (EHR) data and ignore free-text clinical notes, which often contain code-mixed. Preprint, not peer reviewed.

research.title: A Verifier from the Past: Test-Time Compute for Time Series Foundation Models
research.summary: Announce Type: new Abstract: Test-time compute (TTC) improves language models by spending additional inference compute to generate, verify, and select among candidate outputs, but this recipe has not transferred directly to time series forecasting. A language model can verify a. Preprint, not peer reviewed.

research.title: An AI-Powered Multiverse Analysis of Empirical Finance Research: Evidence from Reused Natural Experiments
research.summary: Announce Type: new Abstract: Empirical finance research often reuses natural experiments to study other outcomes, raising concerns about multiple testing and publication bias. We use AI agents to run a multiverse analysis of 324 papers that reuse 13 natural experiments. Preprint, not peer reviewed.

research.title: An LLM-Agentic Framework for Intelligent Work Order Management in Industrial Maintenance
research.summary: Announce Type: new Abstract: This paper presents an AI-driven framework, CodeReAct agent, designed to enhance industrial equipment maintenance through natural language (NL) interactions. The framework employs an advanced AI agentic approach to interpret human instructions, providing knowledge extraction, asset status. Preprint, not peer reviewed.

research.title: AppSci-Bench: Can LLMs Build AI Agents and Make Them Better?
research.summary: Announce Type: new Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used not only to power AI agents but also to build them. While many benchmarks assess the quality of LLM- powered agents, few ascertain how good LLMs are at building. Preprint, not peer reviewed.

research.title: Beyond Weight Updates: Evolving Agent Harnesses for Domain Specialization
research.summary: Announce Type: new Abstract: Domain specialization of LLM agents is usually framed as a weight-update problem: collect trajectories, run reinforcement learning (RL) or supervised fine-tuning (SFT), and deploy a new checkpoint. We study a complementary axis: evolving the \textbf{agent harness}---the. Preprint, not peer reviewed.

research.title: BuggyMLE: Scaling Machine Learning Engineering Difficulty with Bug Injection
research.summary: Announce Type: new Abstract: Enabling AI systems to autonomously improve AI models requires agents capable of performing machine learning engineering (MLE). In practice, designing, training, and evaluating complex models demands modifying multi-file repositories to reproduce results, debug training runs, integrate. Preprint, not peer reviewed.

research.title: Calibrated Decision Rewards: Training Language Models with a Judge That Knows How Sure It Is
research.summary: Announce Type: new Abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) can only teach a language model what its reward can recognize. Answer checkers are exact but need a reference answer, learned reward models and LLM judges work everywhere, but their scores are not. Preprint, not peer reviewed.
